cohort: 33 templates x seeds 0-35 = 1,188 final URDF packages

categories.count: For assets with structured design JSON, select applicable category_anchors from resolved config and require each declared exact_count/count_from role as a one-to-one matched visual-bearing URDF-link lower bound. This does not detect extra decomposition.
categories.numeric: For every movable URDF joint, require a finite non-zero axis and, for revolute/prismatic joints, finite ordered lower/upper limits.
categories.relational: For applicable structured design-JSON anchors, require each declared parent-role/child-role joint relation, joint type, and declared axis in the final URDF.
categories.interface: Per seed, require a valid connected URDF tree, resolvable mesh references, and a passing strict compiler policy gate. This is an operational interface-integrity proxy, not mating-surface metrology.
categories.kinematic: Per seed, require motion-QC collision_free=true, no missing required joint edges or poses, and every reported joint edge covered.
categories.compatibility: Per seed, require the resolved valid configuration to pass strict Full-QC. This measures valid-combination acceptance only.
categories.invalid_combination_rejection: Unsupported in v1: no independently frozen negative configuration manifest and no uniform invalid-config injection API.

matching: Reuse naming_protocol_v2 global maximum-cardinality role assignment for count; relation roles use frozen token-subset matching against final URDF link names.
limitations: Source-derived evidence is not an independent hidden benchmark spec.
Count constraints cover only structured design-JSON assets, are required-role lower bounds, and do not detect extra decomposition.
Numeric constraints validate URDF joint values, not target dimensions from geometry.
Relational constraints cover only assets with structured required_relations in copied design JSON.
Interface and compatibility are operational proxies and partially depend on existing strict QC.
Results are not directly comparable to the paper's 52 hidden GLB constraints.
